title: Companion backlog review rounds are static
description: ADR-058 native proof. Preconditions: `node scripts/agentic/backlog-review-proof.mjs setup` has started the private fixture gateway (holding a pre-migration backlog item whose review round asks for full-live), and the Companion is connected to it (backlog-review-connect). Creates an item with a static round and saves the legacy item, verifying labels on screen and persisted static-code through the fixture gateway. Run `cleanup` afterwards.

text_contains: Static review. Run runtime validation separately with QA.
